classifications.rationale: The President makes the statutory determination supporting a waiver for specified GSP articles and countries; that legally consequential determination occurs in the segment itself.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that it is appropriate to waive the application of section 504(c)

classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the statutorily required national-economic-interest determination after receiving USITC advice; the determination occurs immediately rather than being assigned to an agency.
classifications.evidence: I have determined, based on that advice and on the considerations described in sections 501 and 502(c) of the 1974 Act, as amended and 2462(c)), that such waivers are in the national economic interest of the United States.

classifications.rationale: The President states a determination that an HTS amendment is necessary and appropriate, but this segment neither makes the amendment nor directs an official to produce a specified legal outcome; the legal change occurs elsewhere.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that it is necessary and appropriate to subdivide and amend the nomenclature

classifications.rationale: The President determines that certain countries should later be redesignated, but the segment does not itself redesignate them or mandate an agency to do so; the operative legal change occurs elsewhere.
classifications.evidence: certain countries should be redesignated as beneficiary developing countries

classifications.rationale: The President states that modifying the HTS is necessary and appropriate and recites his statutory authority, but this segment does not itself execute the modification; the legal change occurs elsewhere.
classifications.evidence: I have determined it is necessary and appropriate to modify the HTS.

classifications.rationale: The President directly applies statutory waivers and modifies tariff classifications, eligibility designations, and duty rates through the proclamation itself, with the legal consequences attaching under the stated provisions and dates.
classifications.evidence: The waivers of the application of section 504(c) of the 1974 Act shall apply

classifications.rationale: The President directly supersedes inconsistent prior directives and establishes when the proclamation's waivers and tariff amendments legally take effect; those consequences arise by force of this segment.
classifications.evidence: Any provisions of previous proclamations and Executive orders inconsistent with the provisions of this proclamation are hereby superseded
